content:
neil: Kicking off the region-by-region rollout now. Plan: US canary -> EU small slice -> APAC warm pool warmup. Pinning version r1.23 for canary.
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] canary us-west-2: model=rwd-infer-v2.1 commit=abc123 slot=canary
samantha: Capacity check: US warm pool free GPUs=142, reserved=120. EU warm pool free GPUs=28, reserved=20. APAC warm pool warming: will allocate 30 GPUs.
mike-sre: Observability note: tracing sample=10% for canary, alert rules active for latency>2s or error_rate>1% over 5m.
alisa: Rollback criteria reiterated: latency p95 > 1.8s or errors >1% sustained 5m -> rollback. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --region <r> --to r1.22`
deploy-bot: [metric] canary us-west-2: p50=120ms p90=210ms p95=430ms errors=0.2% tokens/s=452k
neil: Nice. Hold 15m, then step EU to 5% slice if no flags.
samantha: Setting EU slice pin to r1.23 at 5% now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] slice eu-central-1: model=rwd-infer-v2.1 commit=abc123 slice=5%
mike-sre: Warming APAC early, leaving 25% headroom. Monitoring memory OOM trends for multi-tenant slots.
deploy-bot: [metric] eu-central-1 slice=5%: p50=280ms p90=320ms p95=610ms errors=1.5% tokens/s=82k -> hitting error threshold
alisa: EU errors >1% now. Holding rollout. Reducing slice to 1% and will rollback EU to r1.22 if no improvement in 3m.
neil: Agreed. Samantha, pin EU back and flip routing fallback if it doesn't stabilize. Notify PMs.
samantha: Done: EU pin reverted to r1.22, fallback routes applied. Notifying #customer-impact and product.
deploy-bot: [rollback] eu-central-1: automated rollback to r1.22 executed at 1739990500 (trigger=error_rate>1% rule)
mike-sre: After rollback, memory pressure normalized; no OOMs seen. We'll capture logs and perf diffs.
neil: Good call. We'll do a short postmortem tomorrow and include a perf/regression ticket for model variant. For now, proceeding with US -> APAC warmup only.
samantha: APAC warmup in progress, no canary there. Will keep APAC at reduced traffic until we confirm EU patch.
alisa: If APAC latency spikes, we have a manual pin/fallback command ready: `curl -X POST https://ops/api/pin -d '{"region":"apac","version":"r1.22"}'`
deploy-bot: [info] next scheduled check in 5m. All live alerts forwarded to #oncall.
neil: Thanks team. Standby for post-rollout summary and any follow-ups.
